## Saltgrove – Eval Runner
Runs the fixed test set (data table **p2_eval_cases_v3**, 23 cases) through the real support agent (Workflow B, in eval mode: no ticket, Slack, email or log), checks every reply with code, and reports the score.

**1. Load cases** → **2. Run and check each case** → **3. Summarize**

Before a run: write what changed in NOTE inside "Start Run". When a check or a case changes, save the cases as a new table and raise CRITERIA_VERSION; scores are only compared within one version. A full run takes 15–60 minutes, depending on how fast Gemini answers (free tier: 15 requests per minute).

### 1. Load cases
Reads the help documents (for the AI judge) and the test cases in order, and adds this run's ID. ONLY in "Start Run" limits a quick test to a few cases.

### 2. Run and check each case
The agent answers the case. **Code decides pass or fail**: route and triage, facts that must appear, things it must never say, length and format. The **AI judge only flags** claims the help documents don't support, for a person to read; it never changes the score.

### 3. Summarize
Score, score per check group, change since the last run with the same criteria, and failed cases. Saved to **eval_runs** and posted to #eval-runs.
